ideas.title: Self-assessment is the missing ops check for agents
ideas.hook_en: Claude now scores its own reply for misuse right after it answers. OpenAI is publishing how they monitor frontier models in production. As someone who still thinks in alerts and runbooks, this feels late and necessary. I do not want a smarter agent first. I want an agent that can say 'this session went weird' before my cluster pays for it.

ideas.angle: yin min DevOps / Ops Agent lens on Anthropic self-assessment + OpenAI monitoring news — safety as observability, not PR.

ideas.title: Never start your agent in Downloads
ideas.hook_en: I told my Codex and Claude Code friends this morning: do not launch the agent from ~/Downloads. Forever Security found a malicious AGENTS.md sitting there on a real customer machine. Agents trust AGENTS.md by design. Browsers can write into Downloads without a click. That combo is a remote instruction channel into your coding agent. Change the working directory before you type anything.
ideas.video_tip: 15s screencast: open ~/Downloads, highlight a planted AGENTS.md, start Claude Code there vs from a clean repo root, show the trusted-file path as the risk.
ideas.angle: Expand yin min's own CN security warning into EN; first-principles trust-boundary lesson for coding agents.
ideas.why: yinmin1987's own 10-30 tip on malicious AGENTS.md in Downloads (674 views so far); coding-agent / Claude / Codex keywords dominated the board.
ideas.visual: 15s screencast: open ~/Downloads, highlight a planted AGENTS.md, start Claude Code there vs from a clean repo root, show the trusted-file path as the risk.

ideas.title: Your agents are idle because the job is undefined
ideas.hook_en: A post that kept circulating yesterday said the loudest complaint is simple: people set up Grok Bot, Muse, Hermes… then watch them gather dust. I feel that. When I build an Ops Agent the hard part is never wiring the model. It is writing the one sentence: what is this agent allowed to touch, and what does 'done' look like. No use case, no memory design. No memory design, no agent.
ideas.video_tip: 20s talking-head: desk with several agent logos on sticky notes, then flip each note to blank except one labeled 'on-call: restart failed pod + page me' — that one stays.
ideas.angle: yin min building Ops Agent / Memory-RAG: reframes the 'idle agents' meme as a job-definition + memory problem, not a tooling problem.
